name: An Dinh Palace
kicker: Khai Dinh’s palace on the An Cuu
summary: See Khải Định’s private palace on the An Cựu, later the crown prince’s house. The ticket record prints both 97 and 179 Phan Đình Phùng. An adult ticket is 50,000 VND, and a child from 7 to 12 is free. It is not the Imperial City ticket. Minutes inside are Check on arrival.
getThere: On the An Cựu, Phan Đình Phùng. Minutes are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The yellow facade of Khải Tường tower at An Dinh

notice.title: Two street numbers, and a separate ticket
notice.body: The address field says 179 Phan Đình Phùng, Phú Nhuận. The description and the article say số 97 Phan Đình Phùng. Use both until the gate matches one of them. The 200,000 VND Imperial City ticket does not include this palace.

body: An Dinh faces south on the An Cựu. Khải Định, then still Phụng Hóa Công, made a residence here in 1902 and rebuilt it with his own money from 1917 to early 1919. From 28 February 1922 it was the house of Crown Prince Vĩnh Thụy, later Bảo Đại. The family lived here after 1945. The grounds are 23,463 square metres.

Three buildings remain. The main gate is two storeys and three arches, with ceramic relief. Trung Lập, inside the gate, is an octagonal pavilion that held a life-size bronze of Khải Định cast in 1920. Khải Tường tower, behind it, is three storeys and 745 square metres, in the form of a European castle, with murals on the first floor.

An adult ticket is 50,000 VND. A child from 7 to 12 is free. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55 pay half. How long the three buildings take is Check on arrival.

gettingThere: From the south bank, the palace is on the An Cựu along Phan Đình Phùng. The ticket record prints both 179, in Phú Nhuận, and số 97. Confirm the door you are standing at. The minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.body: Phan Đình Phùng, on the An Cựu. The record gives 97 and 179. No published minute count. Check on arrival.
